name: Elf
description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it. They love nature and magic, art and artistry, music and poetry, and the good things the world has to offer.

grants.name: Darkvision (60 ft)
grants.description: See in dim light within 60 ft. as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (no color, only shades of gray).

grants.name: Fey Ancestry
grants.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

grants.name: Trance
grants.description: You don't need to sleep. Instead you meditate deeply for 4 hours a day, gaining the same benefit a human gets from 8 hours of sleep.

grants.name: Elf Weapon Training
grants.description: Proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

grants.name: Cantrip
grants.description: Learn one cantrip from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

grants.name: Extra Language
grants.description: Speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

grants.name: Elf Weapon Training
grants.description: Proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

grants.name: Fleet of Foot
grants.description: Your base walking speed increases to 35 ft.

grants.name: Mask of the Wild
grants.description: You can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

grants.name: Superior Darkvision (120 ft)
grants.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 ft. instead of the usual 60.

grants.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
grants.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you or the target is in direct sunlight.

grants.name: Drow Magic
grants.description: Know the Dancing Lights cantrip. At 3rd level, cast Faerie Fire once per long rest; at 5th level, cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these.

grants.name: Drow Weapon Training
grants.description: Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.
